# Asset Architecture & Design

Provide technical details for your asset below. This document helps the community understand your design, security model, and platform integrations.

A 2–3 sentence high-level summary of how this solution is built and structured on the Salesforce platform.

* **External Integrations:** Named Credentials, External Services, REST/SOAP APIs.
